title: Outgoing Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina Honored by Fire and EMS With White Chief's Helmet

content:
Webb County Fire and EMS honored outgoing County Judge Tano E. Tijerina with a white helmet — the helmet of a fire chief — as he prepares to leave office.

The helmet carries five bugles, the insignia of the highest level of command in the fire service. Tijerina said the gesture meant more than words could express, calling the helmet a symbol of leadership, service, sacrifice and the responsibility of looking after others.

He thanked Chief Ramiro Elizondo and every member of the county's Fire and EMS departments for their trust, friendship and dedication to protecting the community, and said it has been an honor to serve alongside them.

Tijerina, who lost his bid for Texas' 28th Congressional District on Nov. 3, said he will always be proud of what the county accomplished together and grateful for the people who make Webb County special.

Source: Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina.
